notes.title: Demo Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everybody,

It’s been around a month since we [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1678040/view/3517903236738989010]released the demo[/url][/b] of Njorun’s Will. We’d like to thank everyone who tried the demo, recorded or streamed their gameplay, and provided valuable feedback on their experience!

All this content and information allowed us to identify a number of problems that needed to be addressed and, as of now, we’ve already published 5 patches to the demo. Below is the summary of the changes that were introduced thanks to your input.

[h3]Additions and Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Creatures now can be set on fire by flammable bollurs

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42373560/a706bf67b8224c0a9f11eb539754a5dbc746317f.gif[/img]

[*] The player’s melee hit now has better registration
[*] Damage inflicted by thrown telekinetic objects is now better registered
[*] [b]NEW![/b] Several charms now can be found around the location. When a charm is an inventory, it gives a certain buff to the character
[*] The word “simultaneous” is visually added to the Tún gate instruction document to remind the players about this detail (in case the dialog line is missed and the task description is not read)
[*] Texts “Saved” and “Added to Journal” are now displayed along the respective notification icons
[*] [b]NEW![/b] When Health points and Stamina points are lost or restored, they are now animated in a more noticeable way
[*] Journal tutorial is now also available in the Training room and How to Play menu
[*] The information about how the distance of the telekinetic push is changed depending on the object’s distance to the character is added to the Telekinetic Lift tutorial
[*] An additional point in Main Menu called “How to Play Online” linking to an official Steam Remote Play Together page was added (it could be useful for the players who want to play the demo online but are unfamiliar with the feature)
[*] Black screens presenting locations are now displayed for a shorter period of time
[/list]
[h3]Level and Balance changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Interval for periodic damage while stuck in goo is increased: 0.75 -> 1 second
[*] Dungeon pillar activation time is increased: 6 -> 7 seconds
[*] Activation of the dungeon pillars is now more noticeable
[*] The quadrupedal creature now has less HP: 140 -> 100
[*] The capsule size of the quadrupedal creature is decreased in size: height 112 -> 80, radius 80 -> 70 (it’s more nimble now in movements around the location)
[*] The wormlike creature now has less HP: 100 -> 60 
[*] Tutorial information signs in the Training room now have better visibility (it’s more difficult to miss them now)
[*] The recharge time for the “gas emitting platform” is increased: 5.5 -> 8 seconds
[*] Automatic comments on receiving the first damage in water and in goo are removed 
[*] Damage from a thrown telekinetic object is increased: 10 -> 20
[*] The velocity of the thrown telekinetic object is greatly increased (makes it easier to hit the target)
[*] An additional box with flammable bollurs and a “gas emitting platform” are added to the second island in the docks area (it’s needed for the players to get familiarized with the flammable bollurs mechanic in a relatively “peaceful” environment)
[*] The shield that was located in the starting docks is now removed (it’s not really needed at this stage, but it made players think it’s somehow required so they often carried it through the level)
[/list]
[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] The demo can’t be accidentally finished now with a world map that doesn’t have a map point for traveling
[*] The possibility for characters to mutually indefinitely lift each other with a single or two shields in its current form is removed (currently, this exploit  totally breaks the game as it also allows hoverboarding horizontally over the location, essentially bypassing all the obstacles, puzzles and creatures)
[*] Reviving a character a few frames before his death now doesn’t lead to “game over”
[*] The shields now can’t fall under the ground in some rare situations
[*] Players now can’t walk underwater in some rare scenarios
[*] Falling telekinetic objects can’t deal damage anymore (only flying due to telekinetic push can)
[*] The game doesn’t attempt to launch the Steam VR headset upon startup if it’s plugged in anymore
[/list]
We will continue listening to your feedback and “sharpening the concept” of the game presented in the demo. We encourage you to record your play session and share it with us in some form so we could learn from you and improve the game.

Let us know what you think here or on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/KXmqvuJfVb]Discord Server[/url][/b]!

Wishlist and Follow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/

Thanks,
gul3n

notes.title: Demo is Out!
notes.content:
We are happy to announce that the Concept Demo of Njorun’s Will is released on Steam! 

[previewyoutube=bMJx4lccm-Y;full][/previewyoutube]

Head to Njorun’s Will Steam page to download it. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/

Note, there are a few limitations in the demo: 

[list]
[*] At the moment, it can be played only with a controller
[*] Local co-op is available. To play co-op online, please use Steam Remote Play together feature
[*] English is the only language currently supported in the demo
[/list]

Let us know about your gameplay experience on the [url=https://discord.gg/KXmqvuJfVb]Discord[/url] server!

notes.title: Let’s Localize It!
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

We would like to initiate a [b]community collaboration[/b] to localize our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/]Steam Page[/url][/b]. At the moment, we would like to focus on the following languages:

[list]
[*] Portuguese (Brazilian)
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish (Spain)
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean
[*] Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Chinese (Traditional)
[*] Turkish
[*] Polish
[/list]

If you are a native speaker of one of the aforementioned languages and you’d like to collaborate with us on localizing the texts of Njorun’s Will Steam Page, be free to join the initiative on the [b][url=https://www.localizor.com/njoruns-will]Localizor[/url][/b]. Currently, there are 14 strings in total that need localization.

If you have any game or localization-related questions, join our [b][url=https://discord.gg/KXmqvuJfVb]Discord Community[/url][/b] to discuss them in the corresponding channels.

[h3]Credits[/h3]

All translators will be added to the game credits. Contact us on [b][url=https://discord.gg/KXmqvuJfVb]Discord[/url][/b] and tell us your name (or nickname) you want to be displayed in the credits. You will also get a special [i]"Localizer"[/i] role that’s going to be reflected in our Discord Community.

Later on, we will start the localization project for the Concept Demo itself.

Wishlist and Follow to stay informed! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/

Thanks,
[i]gul3n[/i]

notes.title: On Future Plans
notes.content:
Hello, my alias is [i]gul3n[/i], I am one of the developers working on Njorun’s Will. Our small team consists of 3 people and is called [i]quadruped[/i].

We are glad to announce that on the 10th of May 2022, just around a week ago, we launched our [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/]Steam Page[/url][/b]!

Despite the fact that a lot of important pieces of content are still in progress and can’t be displayed just yet, we thought now would be the right time to finally start talking about Njorun’s Will. 

The game has been in development for quite some time, although we consider that it is still in the early stages of its production cycle. The iterative process Njorun’s Will has been through is quite interesting to show and talk about, so it is something I will definitely write about in a separate post later on. 

[h3]Concept Demo[/h3]

We are currently working toward finishing the Concept Demo of the game, a build meant to display the variety of Njorun’s Will gameplay. We will conduct several playtest sessions along the way prior to releasing the Concept Demo on Steam. I believe we are several months away from reaching this major milestone.

[h3]Communication[/h3]

In the coming months, we will share a lot of interesting information with you here, in Community Hub: 
[list]
[*] insights about the game and its features 
[*] fresh content 
[*] various news and announcements
[/list]

In case you have any questions about the game, you can always ask them here or on our [b][url=https://discord.gg/KXmqvuJfVb]Discord Server[/url][/b].

Wishlist and Follow to keep in touch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1678040/Njoruns_Will/

Thanks,
[i]gul3n[/i]
